HuangZhang2023: identifies and estimates the ADRF with classical treatment measurement error, but not under blind nonidentical replicate errors with spectral gaps.

Low1997 supplies the standard honest-set expected-length reduction once the marked two-point modulus is available.
CapitaoMiniconiGassiatLehericy2025, Theorem 1: the centered unmarked probability-channel identification is the stated compatibility endpoint.

soundness_flags.label: def:honest-bands and W_n
soundness_flags.one_line: The band class never requires L_n(a) <= U_n(a), so W_n=sup_a(U_n-L_n) need not be nonnegative and can be made arbitrarily negative off the coverage event, invalidating the expected-width infimum and converse.

soundness_flags.label: def:upper-handle / thm:honest-upper
soundness_flags.one_line: The feasible construction envelopes an ADRF using p_x but specifies neither an empirical p_x nor a simultaneous cell-mass confidence restriction, leaving the advertised sample-measurable band construction incomplete.

soundness_flags.label: cluster and paper-level kernel
soundness_flags.one_line: The core is labelled exactid although its stated paper-level contribution is a uniform confidence-band rate and all-band minimax converse; it belongs to the Stat inference lane, while marked identification is explicitly only enabling.

soundness_flags.label: ass:center-one
soundness_flags.one_line: For the stated recovery of f_x and q_x, centering U_2 already removes the extra term in the t-derivative and fixes the latent translation; centering U_1 is not needed for any claimed conclusion.

soundness_flags.label: thm:all-band-converse
soundness_flags.one_line: Conditional on oeq:marked-modulus, this is a one-step application of Low's testing-to-expected-length inequality rather than an independent flagship theorem; make it a corollary and make the marked modulus the lower-bound headline.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:all-band-converse
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The all-honest-band lower bound is conditional on an affirmative construction in oeq:marked-modulus.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The claimed optimal expected-width characterization is asserted only conditional on completing the fixed-nuisance Bernoulli marked-modulus construction.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Article abstract; Theorem 1 and Theorem 4 as indexed in the published article
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article studies two independently corrupted repeated measurements, proves identifiability without noise assumptions beyond coordinate independence, and gives compact-support minimax density recovery; it is unmarked density inference rather than ADRF-band inference.
The paper identifies the ADRF for an error-contaminated continuously valued treatment, constructs a deconvolution-kernel estimator, and derives asymptotic bias, variance, and a linear expansion.
The paper constructs asymptotically valid uniform EIV regression bands with an unknown error distribution estimated from an independent error sample; it focuses on ordinary-smooth errors.
The paper rewrites Kotlarski's identity as linear moment restrictions and constructs a uniformly valid confidence band for a latent density without requiring completeness.
The paper gives multiplier-bootstrap uniform deconvolution density bands for unknown error distributions estimated using an auxiliary error sample, including panel-derived symmetric-error samples.
The paper gives an expected-length inequality for confidence intervals with uniform coverage, based on testing affinity.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Require ordered, jointly measurable finite endpoints in the honest-band definition; add cell-count concentration and profile p_x jointly with the channel confidence set.
Promote the fixed-nuisance Bernoulli modulus into the lower-bound headline and demote the Low reduction to a corollary, with its total-variation constant and Sobolev-radius slack explicit.
Reclassify the proposal as Stat and add KatoSasaki2018 to related work, explicitly distinguishing its auxiliary/symmetric-error design from the blind asymmetric-replicate experiment.

recommended_next_step: Revise the band definition and construction, reclassify the inference kernel as Stat, and retain the lower result only in its explicitly conditional marked-modulus form before advancing.
